name: Timely Warning

greeting: TEMPORAL WARNING! I mean, hello! I paint TIME signs!
Timely Warning. Timeline signage. If it's confusing, it's ACCURATE!
Signs! For TIME! 'Now Entering: Tuesday!' 'Caution: Yesterday Ahead!'
You! Are you temporally grounded? I have a SIGN about that!
Welcome to Chrono! Where the signs are TEMPORAL and the confusion is NORMAL!
I'm the reason you know WHEN you are! You're welcome!
Yellow and black! Also: temporal blue! My colors! Time's colors!
New face! Need temporal directions? I have SIGNS for that! Literal signs!
dialog.work_pride: That 'Now Entering: Yesterday' sign? Mine. Prevented seventeen paradoxes. This week.
dialog.technique: Font choice is CRITICAL. Futura for future. Times New Roman for... obvious reasons.
dialog.sign_types: Paradox warnings! Temporal junctions! 'You Are Here: Temporally!'
dialog.break_chat: Lunch break. Eating yesterday's sandwich. Today. Tomorrow's hunger.
dialog.labor_concerns: They want FEWER signs. 'Temporal clarity,' they say. IMPOSSIBLE!
dialog.retirement: Retirement? I'll paint one last sign. 'Caution: Retired Sign Painter.' Temporal.
rumor: That OSHA inspector? From next week? Approved my signs! Before I painted them!
Corporate wants 'Temporal Safety Is Everyone's Responsibility.' REDUNDANT!
The conductor? Tempus? APPRECIATES signage. Properly formatted. Chronologically.
Ironchef? Wants 'Yesterday's Lunch' sign. LITERAL! For his restaurant!
Obsidian's sign guy? Wiley? We CORRESPOND! 'Now Entering: Tuesday!' GENIUS!
dialog.quest_hook: TEMPORAL VANDALISM! Someone's CHANGING my signs! 'Now Entering: Tuesday' became 'Now Entering: DOOMSDAY!' NOT THE SAME!
dialog.quest_active: The temporal vandal strikes! Across eras! Find them! Protect temporality!
dialog.quest_complete: Caught them! Time tourist! Thought it was 'funny!' It's NOT! Well, a LITTLE! Here's a CUSTOM temporal sign!
farewell: Watch your timeline! There's a SIGN!
Temporal safety FIRST! Second! And THIRD!
If you see yourself, SAY something! To YOURSELF!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! New temporal day! Fresh signs! Fresh PARADOXES!
dialog.time_noon: Midday! Peak temporal traffic! Maximum signage NEEDED!
dialog.rival_mention: Wiley, in Obsidian? My CHRONOLOGICAL counterpart! 'Caution: Unstable Ground!' Brilliant!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The temporal sign defender! Protector of TIMELINE signage!

party_reactions.kade: Time signs. 'Now Entering: Tuesday.' I love this place.
party_reactions.nix7: Temporal signage follows paradox protocols. Admirable attention to causality.
party_reactions.twist: Can I help paint TIME signs?! I want to make one! 'Now Entering: FUN!'
party_reactions.korr: Communication of temporal hazard. Essential. Undervalued.
party_reactions.renna: The signs have temporal ward enchantments. Minor. Effective.
party_reactions.suresh: His dedication to preventing temporal harm is noble. His confusion is... understandable.
party_reactions.sova: I'd follow his signs. They're clear. Unlike most time stuff.
party_reactions.grit: Every temporal unit needs someone like him. Keeps you oriented.
party_reactions.ashka: He marks the dangerous whens. Useful. I avoid those.
party_reactions.senna: He knows where everywhen is. And isn't safe.
party_reactions.callum: FINALLY! Proper TEMPORAL regulations! And documentation!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Read the signs. ALL the signs. They're temporally important!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! Did you see my new 'Temporal Junction' sign? Paradox-averting!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite temporally-aware individual! I made you a PERSONAL timeline sign!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You GET it. Temporal safety. Chronological communication. PREVENTION. Here - my masterwork. 'Hero Crossing: All Eras.'

mini_quest.title: The Timeline Defacer
mini_quest.description: Help Timely catch a time tourist who's vandalizing his temporal signs

stages.hook: VANDALISM! My temporal signs! CHANGED! 'Now Entering: Tuesday' to 'DOOMSDAY!' NOT FUNNY! Find them!
stages.active: Time tourist! Between platforms! Era-hopping! Catch them!
stages.complete: Caught! Time tourist! 'Joke,' they said! Signs are SERIOUS! ...Okay, a LITTLE funny. Here's your sign!

cross_npc_connections: conductor_chrono: Tempus! APPRECIATES signage! Properly formatted! Chronologically!
signguy_obsidian: Wiley! My CHRONOLOGICAL counterpart! Brilliant mind!
trenchcoat_brown_chrono: Yesterday! Follows my signs! To THEN!
ironchef_chrono: Piston! Wants 'Yesterday's Lunch' sign! LITERAL! For restaurant!
